description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the number of "Factual Errors" across four different datasets for three distinct question-answering methods. The horizontal category axis displays the datasets in the following order from left to right: HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC. The vertical value axis represents the number of errors on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 5. Neither axis has an explicit overall title. The chart features grouped bars, where each dataset category contains a cluster of three bars representing different methods, as indicated by the legend in the top right. The methods are "NoR QA" (orange with a grid pattern), "OneR QA" (red with a dotted pattern), and "IRCoT QA" (dark blue with diagonal stripes). Each bar is visually emphasized by being annotated with its exact numerical value directly above it. Within each group, the bars are arranged in the order of NoR QA, OneR QA, and IRCoT QA. For HotpotQA, the values are 15, 10, and 5, respectively, with the IRCoT QA bar at 5 being the shortest in the entire chart. For 2WikiMQA, the values are 29 (the tallest bar overall), 23, and 14. For MuSiQue, the values are 28, 27, and 23. Finally, for IIRC, the values are 15, 14, and 11. Across all four categories, the bar heights consistently decrease from left to right within each group.
